name: Fx_Group_DestroyEmitters
summary: Destroys all active emitters in an emitter group: releases their child nodes and animation links, decrements template refcounts on the FX manager, unlinks them from manager lists, and unlinks the group via 0x005306CC.
evidence: Matches Fx_DestroyEmitter (0x0052F4D4) inline loop over group->f_10 emitters with tag check iVar2->f_24 == group->f_c; frees child nodes with 0x005209D8, animation link via 0x00529B50, updates template refcount at iVar2->f_1c+4, and unlinks group via 0x005306CC.

name: Fx_System_UpdateChannelGroups
signature: unsigned int Fx_System_UpdateChannelGroups(Fx_System* self, unsigned int list, int channel, int flag)
summary: Advances the FX system clock and updates all active emitter groups attached to a given channel list, ticking sub-steps via 0x0051D25C and updating emitter nodes through Fx_Group_UpdateEmitters (0x005304AC).
evidence: Belongs to Fx_System (offsets +0x488/+0x48C 64-bit clock, +0x120 channel list table, +0x460/+0x464 stats in callee 0x005304AC); walks group->f_27c links and ticks active emitter groups instead of scene units.

name: maybe_Thumb_MisidentifiedEntry
summary: Spurious entry point inside ARM function maybe_Mem_PoolSlot_Allocate (0x00530014): offset +0x40 is an ARM 'bl 0x00504F30' instruction misdecoded as Thumb push.
evidence: Disassembly in asm/text/text_00500048.s shows unbroken ARM instructions from 0x00530014; 0x00530054 word 0xEBFF53B5 is ARM 'bl #0x00504F30', not a function entry.

name: Fx_Group_UpdateEmitters
signature: int Fx_Group_UpdateEmitters(Fx_System* self, int arg2, Fx_EmitterGroup* group, int skipStart, unsigned int* params)
summary: Updates each active emitter in an effect emitter group: calls emitter lifecycle methods (+8 start, +0x10 update, +0x14 sub-step), accumulates particle and quad stats onto the FX system, and unlinks the group via 0x005306CC when empty.
evidence: Caller 0x0052F988 passes Fx_System and channel group; iterates group->f_10 emitter entries, checking emitter->f_24 == group->f_c and updating FX manager stat fields +0x460/+0x464/+0x46C/+0x480/+0x4D8.

name: Fx_Billboard_CalcBasisMatrix
signature: void Fx_Billboard_CalcBasisMatrix(float* outMatrix, const float* inAxes, const float* viewMatrix)
summary: Calculates an orthonormal billboard 3x3 orientation matrix from input axes and view matrix: normalizes the forward axis via 0x0053427C and computes the cross product with 0x0051B70C.
evidence: Destination receives three 3-float basis vectors at offsets 0, +4, +8 (stride 4 floats), not a single point; uses vector normalization (0x0053427C) and cross product (0x0051B70C) to produce an orthonormal billboard orientation matrix.

name: Fx_InitQuadSlotIndices
summary: Initializes an array of four slot or index words to 0xFFFFFFFF (-1) via 0x0051CF40 and returns the slots pointer.
evidence: Callee 0x0051CF40 is 'mvn r1, #0; str r1, [r0]; bx lr', which writes 0xFFFFFFFF into *r0. 0x005346B4 calls it four times with r0, r0+4, r0+8, r0+0xC, subtracts 0xC to restore the pointer, and returns r0. It initializes four index/slot words, not measuring a batch.

name: maybe_Ui_System_SetSlotPoolParam

name: Ui_Resource_FreeTaggedBlock
summary: Frees a tagged memory buffer through the global UI allocator hook retrieved via 0x006BA1DC, passing the arena tag bits and cleared pointer.

name: Ui_Material_GetColor
signature: void Ui_Material_GetColor(unsigned int* outColor, const void* material, int colorIndex)
summary: Retrieves a 32-bit color from an nw::lyt Material: reads primary color slots for indices 0..1, maps indices 2..6 through the texture pattern palette via 0x0065DE7C, or returns 0xFFFFFFFF.

Second argument is an nw::lyt Material with flags at +0x74, TevColor array at +0x6C, and stage table at 0x0065DE7C. Reads specific material color indices rather than generic resource values.
